literal: Willpower desiring, courage as companion, he who went; return desiring, still I exist.
translation: Desiring strength of will, he departed with only his courage as a companion; desiring his return, I still cling to life.
modern: மனவலிமையை விரும்பி, தன் நெஞ்சத்தையே துணையாகக் கொண்டு சென்ற காதலர் திரும்பி வருவதை விரும்பி, நான் இன்னும் உயிரோடு இருக்கிறேன்.
explanation: The heroine speaks of her departed lover who left her to achieve a difficult task, driven by his strong willpower (உரன்) and accompanied only by his own courageous heart (உள்ளம்). Though his absence is painful, she explains that she keeps herself alive solely out of the intense desire (நசைஇ) to see him return (வரல்). The repetition of the word 'நசைஇ' (desiring) contrasts his desire for achievement with her desire for his return, highlighting the emotional tension between duty and love.
